= Versioning and publication policy

== RC source cohort and post-1.0 independence

All 25 packages start at +1.0.0-rc.10+. The candidate tag is +v1.0.0-rc.10+ and is not materialized by this source delivery.

During the release-candidate series, internal dependencies use +>=1.0.0-rc.10 <1.0.0+. After 1.0, packages may receive independent patches; compatibility is determined by the generated package manifest and consumer lockfile, never global version equality. The default stable range is +>=1.0.0 <1.1.0+.

== Reproducibility and authorization

Every artifact is tied to one clean source SHA and canonical SHA-256 digests. Path dependencies and dependency overrides are forbidden in publishable archives. Publication stops on the first failure and may resume only with identical source and digests.

Green gates do not authorize a tag, GitHub Release, or pub.dev publication. Those actions require a separate post-merge authorization.
